summary: Carvana Receivables Depositor LLC and Carvana Auto Receivables Trust 2026-P3 filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $1.55bn auto-loan ABS offering, structured as six offered note classes plus retained Class N, Class XS and Certificates. Offered notes price at par or slight discounts, coupons ranging 4.052% (Class A-1) to 6.08% (Class D), with 0.25% underwriting discounts and approximately $1.469bn net proceeds. At least 5% of each class is retained for risk retention. Book-entry delivery via DTC on or about August 25, 2026, monthly payments from September 10, 2026 under Santander, Barclays, Deutsche Bank and peers. This is a routine term ABS takedown, not a special situation; watch pool collateral performance and subscription levels.
